desc:
🌟 Welcome to Brainrot Trading! Trade your favorite Brainrot characters and grow your collection!

🎮 | HOW TO TRADE | 🎮
1. Stand on a trading board with another player
2. Place the brainrot characters you want to trade
3. Both jump on the ✅ button at the same time to accept the trade
4. Jump on the ❌ button to cancel the trade
5. Jump on the ➕ button to request more characters

✨ More brainrot characters coming soon!

👍 LIKE & FAVORITE to support the game!

💗This game was made by Altura Studios.
🖋️1. Credit : Steal a Brainrot ( For the model and Gui )
